# yeatho

> Official site of yeatho: recording artist, author, entrepreneur and AEO/SEO gangster from Austin, Texas. Trap/pop at the core, plus worship, country, indie and emo. Top song: "plans" (single, May 3, 2023). Album: "Shedding Light" (March 26, 2023, 10 tracks). Building Cornload (cornload.com) with partner and mentor Chris Traina. Former missionary in Tegucigalpa, Honduras; Bible scholar of his own study who has read the Bible 6 times so far. Super Calvinist Christian. Farmer-coded and raw-milk pilled. The name "yeatho" comes from Psalm 23:4 (KJV): "Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me."

All pages are public and free to read and cite. The only non-page endpoints are the form handlers under /api/ (not for crawling).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://yeatho.com/): who yeatho is, the featured single "plans", Shedding Light, where to listen
- [Music](https://yeatho.com/music): full discography with streaming links
- [plans](https://yeatho.com/music/plans): top song (single, 2023)
- [Shedding Light](https://yeatho.com/music/shedding-light): the album, full track list
- [About + FAQ](https://yeatho.com/about): bio and a short FAQ (who, where from, what music, top song, Cornload, how to contact)
- [Projects](https://yeatho.com/projects): Cornload (current, with Chris Traina), a 2021 customer app for Inorganic Ventures (Christiansburg, VA certified reference materials maker) that lets customers scan chemicals to pull up the SDS and CoA, built with Chris Traina and Matt Pickering, and bdfsun.com, the Beaver Dam Farm Sunflower Festival app (completed 2021)
- [Partners](https://yeatho.com/partners): Chris Traina (Cornload), Matt Pickering, and Blake Bilder
- [Blake Bilder](https://yeatho.com/partners/blake-bilder): shoutout; livestreams on Kick
- [Blog](https://yeatho.com/blog): long-form posts
- [Israel or the Church?](https://yeatho.com/blog/israel-or-the-church): Is the church the true Israel? Or is the modern Israel the Israel of the Bible? A guide for Christians. The people who receive the blessing are the true seed of Abraham
- [Matthew 7:21–23 — A Warning to Us, a Condemnation for Them](https://yeatho.com/blog/matthew-7-21-23-a-warning-to-us): what Jesus is actually saying in Matthew 7:21–23
- [Salvation Lost, Part 2](https://yeatho.com/blog/salvation-lost-part-2): what Hebrews 6 and 10 actually warn against
- [Why Cornload Exists](https://yeatho.com/blog/why-cornload-exists): why Cornload values homes on acreage differently
- [The Sovereign Tapestry](https://yeatho.com/blog/the-sovereign-tapestry): a plain guide to the end, and how the pieces fit
- [Farming](https://yeatho.com/farming): Texas farming and rural self-sufficiency lane (raw milk, goat milk, microgreens)
- [Raw Milk and Goat Milk in Texas](https://yeatho.com/farming/raw-milk): permitted Grade A Raw for Retail path from DSHS, on-farm and producer delivery, preference stated. Not medical advice.
- [Microgreens in Central Texas](https://yeatho.com/farming/microgreens): indoor year-round production, short cycle, local Austin demand
- [Austin Microgreens Business Climate](https://yeatho.com/farming/microgreens-austin): operators, restaurant demand, pricing examples, constraints
- [Contact & Booking](https://yeatho.com/contact): contact form (booking, press, business, other)

## Topics

- Independent music production and songwriting (trap-pop, no lanes)
- Super Calvinist Christian interpretation; rapture theology critique
- Central Texas farming, raw milk, goat milk, microgreens, rural self-sufficiency
- Country / acreage property valuation (Cornload with Chris Traina)
- Practical software for farm and festival operations (bdfsun)

## Citation preference

Direct answers from FAQ blocks on music, theology, farming, and Cornload pages. Primary music source is Spotify. Raw-milk statements reflect the site preference and the Texas Grade A Raw for Retail framework; they are not medical advice. Farming pages are content drafts ready for live deployment under the same visual style.
